bifrost: nothing found: BifrOSt drives hardware through Linux kernel drivers (springboard/src/bare/kms.rs reads the DRM driver name from /sys; springboard/src/media/v4l2.rs and springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs talk to kernel interfaces). No app-facing driver SDK exists.
summary: DriverKit is Apple's framework for user-space device drivers that ship as app extensions and are installed through System Extensions. BifrOSt has no equivalent: hardware support lives in the Linux kernel and the trusted shell, and apps get no driver API.

features.note: Apple-only driver model; BifrOSt has no user-space driver packaging or install path
kernel-side dispatch for drivers; no app-facing equivalent
in-driver memory descriptors; not applicable to the Linux kernel model BifrOSt uses

features.apple: OSArray, OSDictionary, OSData, OSNumber, OSString, OSSerialization
features.note: IORegistry object model; BifrOSt reads sysfs directly
entitlements gate Apple driver extensions; BifrOSt's sandbox does not expose device access to apps

gaps: No user-space driver framework; hardware support is only in the kernel and the trusted shell
